items.title: Unit 3 · Story
items.scene: Luke is at ___.
items.prompt: Listen and choose the word.
items.storyText: It's June. Luke and his cute mule walk on the sand. Luke sees a bone in the sand. It is a big bone. He has a mule and a rope. Luke and his mule pull the bone with the rope. Luke is at home. He puts the big bone on the cube. Luke and his mule are happy.
items.why: In “Luke and the Bone”, you hear: Luke is at home. The missing word is “home”.
items.hint: Listen to this sentence again. Look at the story picture.
items.sourceLabel: Oxford Phonics World 3, Unit 3, p.31 · Titi narration of the supplied textbook text
